title: 05. Rumble, Rumble! Carrying Soil
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Rumble, rumble! The ground shakes in the distance. A big truck passes by with a mountain of soil piled inside. Hori's ears perk up. Wow! What's that big truck? Rumble, rumble! Loading and carrying soil!
Dad, how can that truck carry so much soil? Hori asks, bouncing while holding Dad's hand. Dad smiles. Shall we visit the building site where the truck works? Kongi can come, too!

Dust floats through the building site, where a big yellow dump truck stands. Hello! Have you come to learn about dump trucks? A driver in an orange vest and a yellow hard hat waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

Wow! The wheels are taller than me! Hori looks up at a huge wheel. These big wheels carry the truck over rocky ground and sticky mud. The driver pats the wheel. Even a heavy load of soil won't stop them.

Behind the cab is a big truck bed, full of soil and gravel. Wow! It's like an acorn storehouse! Kongi mistakes a stone for an acorn and picks it up. The driver laughs. That's a pebble, Kongi. The truck bed is a big container for heavy soil.

How do you pour all that soil out? Hori asks. The driver pulls a handle in the cab. Rumble! The truck bed slowly tilts upward. A strong mechanism lifts it so the soil can slide out. Wow! It pours out by itself!

Would Hori like to sit in the driver's seat? Carefully holding the steps, Hori climbs up high and looks down at the world below. The steering wheel is so big he needs both arms to reach around it. Wow! Sitting here makes me feel so tall!

Now it's time to dump real soil! With the driver's hand helping his, Hori pulls the handle. Rumble! The truck bed tilts, and soil slides out! His tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I dumped the soil, too! Rumble, rumble! Loading and carrying soil!

Beside them, an excavator scoops up soil and loads it into the dump truck. When the bed is full, the truck rumbles away to carry the soil to another place. Hori and Kongi wave. Good luck carrying the soil!

On the way home, Hori holds Dad's hand and chats. Big wheels travel over rocky ground. The truck bed carries lots of soil, and pulling the handle tips it to pour the soil out! A dump truck is a strong worker that carries heavy soil. Hori smiles at the sky. Rumble, rumble! Loading and carrying soil!
